agentConfigs.title: Agent settings
agentConfigs.description: Click each agent's configure icon to adjust its model, tool execution, and system prompt.
agentConfigs.modelVisionFilterNote: Models known to lack image input are hidden; models with unknown capabilities (e.g. self-hosted) remain selectable.

dialog.description: Adjust this agent's model, tool execution, and system prompt.

roleDescription.orchestrator: The only agent that talks to you: plans the work, confirms intent, and dispatches the specialist subagents below.
roleDescription.explorer: Surveys the worldbook, novel structure, timeline, corpus, and the web; a pure reader that reports findings with ids.
roleDescription.curator: Creates, updates, deletes, and reorders worldbook entities (characters and phases, locations, items, lore, events) and their images.
roleDescription.scribe: Manages the user's notes — search, read, create, update, delete.
roleDescription.historian: Synthesizes story state for the other agents — plot threads, chronology, continuity risks; zero write tools.
roleDescription.editor: Structural creation support and repair on world covers, novels, chapters, and scenes — CRUD, reorder, images, scene gallery.
roleDescription.plotter: Outlines at scene level — creates scenes with element references, writing requirements, and word targets, ready for the Writers.
roleDescription.writer: Drafts one scene per dispatch against its requirements and references via update_scene; no scene create/delete/reorder.
roleDescription.critic: Acceptance review after a writing round — chapter structure, per-scene requirements, transitions; reports actionable issues.
roleDescription.namer: Automatically generates a short title for a conversation after its first reply. Leave the model unconfigured to disable it.
roleDescription.vision: Provides image descriptions for chat models without vision (powers the look_at tool). Leave the model unassigned to disable.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: The only role you chat with — it dispatches every specialist below.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Specialists dispatched by the Orchestrator, each with a lean toolset.

utilities.title: Utilities
utilities.description: One-shot background roles — each runs a single call when triggered, never a conversation.

dialog.title: Apply model to all unconfigured
dialog.description: Binds the selected model to the {{count}} agents without a model.
dialog.visionNote: Includes "Vision": it needs an image-capable model — configure it separately if your choice is text-only.

autoExecute.title: Auto-execute tools
autoExecute.description: When enabled, creation tools execute without asking for confirmation each time.

shellTool.title: Shell tool
shellTool.description: When enabled, the agent gains a shell tool that runs commands on this machine without confirmation.

warning.title: Enable shell tool?
warning.body: The agent reads worldbuilding text that could contain hidden prompt injections, which may trick it into running commands you never intended. Those commands run with your full OS user privileges, and they are not confined to this World — they can read or modify anything on your machine.

contextCompaction.title: Context compaction
contextCompaction.description: When enabled, tool calls older than a few turns are compacted to stubs. Use the context_read tool to expand them.

turnAge.title: Compaction threshold (turns)
turnAge.description: Tool calls older than this many turns are compacted. Default 3.

maxSteps.title: Max steps
maxSteps.description: Maximum loop steps per run before the run force-finishes (max-steps). Choose Default to use the built-in 30.

contextNote.title: Context note
contextNote.description: A custom guideline appended to the end of this agent's <context> block. Leave empty for none.
contextNote.placeholder: e.g. "Keep reports concise and cite entity ids" — appended as background guidance.
